title: contracts/settings.json
description: The app's settings model for settings-and-preferences' check-settings.mjs. Paths are repo-relative; regexes are JavaScript source strings matched against code with comments masked.

schema.description: Where the strict valibot object of the settings lives. `export` is a name, or a name with <n> (SETTINGS_V<n>): the newest version across every file the glob matches is checked.

defaults.description: The object literal of first-launch values.

reducer.description: The pure reducer file: one `case '<action>'` per action.

store.description: The store file: the first `persist` match must come before the first `publish` match.

storage.description: The only files that may write the settings to a storage SDK, and the key they use.

screenDirs.description: Folders whose code dispatches the row actions (the settings screen, an onboarding language step).

entries.description: Globs of the files the app starts from. A field's effect, and the screen code that dispatches its action, count only when one of these imports them, directly or through other files (type-only imports do not count). Default: every file under the routes folder (the root layout and the routes) and <servicesDir>/create-device-services.ts (the composition root). A React Navigation app lists its App.tsx or navigator file.

effectExclude.description: Globs where a read never counts as the setting's effect (the model, its storage, the screen). Tests never count.

fields.description: Every saved field, in schema order.

schema.description: The validator source, compared without whitespace.

action.description: The action that changes it (listed in actions).

effect.description: Regex of the read that applies it, outside effectExclude.

unit.description: 'percent': every effect file that reads it converts at the edge.

scale.description: Regex of that conversion (default: a division by 100).

clamp.description: The function the reducer calls to keep the value in range.

rowExempt.description: Actions no screen dispatches (sent by code, such as a migration helper).

accountPreferences.description: Names of preferences the server owns (an email opt-in, an account's notification categories, profile visibility). They are server state (a query and an optimistic mutation through the ApiClient), never a settings field: the checker fails when one appears in fields or the schema.

resets.description: Data resets that must keep the settings.

owner.description: The skill that creates the file (for the not-yet-created SKIP).

keeps.description: Identifiers the reset body never names: the settings, their storage, a whole-store clear.

publishWith.description: Document mode only: the function every caller wraps the reset in, so every store re-reads (state-management-zustand's updateAndPublish). The document write sits inside its write callback: updateAndPublish(stores, () => ...documents.update(resetAllProgress, { refreshBackup: true })...). Leave it out for a key-value app: there state-management-zustand checks its crossStoreWrites.

toggleFeedback.description: Regex of the switch feedback call the screen code makes after a dispatch (default: audio-and-haptics-feedback's playUiFeedback(services, 'toggle'), wired as the model input onToggled); null when the app plays none.

restartCall.description: Regex of the call that restarts the app to apply a layout direction (default: rtl-and-direction's restartForDirection call). In screen code it must sit in a handler whose name says restart (onRestartNow) or after the restart decision (restartDecision) in the same handler.

restartDecision.description: Regex of the restart decision (default: isRestartNeeded, or a comparison with readLayoutDirection()).
